user.title: Add a soil probe
user.description: Pick the probe's raw AD sensor if it has one, otherwise its moisture % sensor. Only raw AD can be calibrated dry and wet.

data_description.name: The probe's device name, for example its location.
data_description.model: Sets the default calibration. Pick Generic if your probe isn't listed.
data_description.raw_ad_entity: The probe's raw reading. Use this when the probe has one.
data_description.moisture_entity: Only for a probe without a raw AD sensor. Its percentage can be corrected on the device page.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: Generic probes have no default calibration. Enter the probe's raw AD reading at 0 % and at 100 % moisture. You can change both later on the device page.

error.one_source: Pick either a raw AD sensor or a moisture % sensor, not both.
error.span_too_small: Must be at least 10 above the 0 % reading.

init.title: Sources
init.description: Pick the probe's raw AD sensor if it has one, otherwise its moisture % sensor. Only raw AD can be calibrated dry and wet.

data_description.raw_ad_entity: The probe's raw reading. Use this when the probe has one.
data_description.moisture_entity: Only for a probe without a raw AD sensor. Its percentage can be corrected on the device page.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: Generic probes have no default calibration. Enter the probe's raw AD reading at 0 % and at 100 % moisture. You can change both later on the device page.

error.one_source: Pick either a raw AD sensor or a moisture % sensor, not both.
error.span_too_small: Must be at least 10 above the 0 % reading.

span_too_small.message: The 100 % reading must be at least {min_span} above the 0 % reading.

point_out_of_range.message: The calibration point would be {value}, outside {min}–{max}.

one_source.message: Give either a raw AD sensor or a moisture % sensor, not both.

ad_needs_raw.message: Raw AD at 0 % and at 100 % only apply with a raw AD sensor.

calibration_needed.message: {probe} is a Generic probe with no default calibration: give its raw AD at 0 % and at 100 %.

set_sources.name: Set sources
set_sources.description: Sets a probe's sensors, for example after replacing the probe. The sensors given become the probe's sensors: a battery sensor left out is removed.

device_id.name: Probe
device_id.description: The probe's device. With several, each gets the same sensors.

raw_ad_entity.name: Raw AD sensor
raw_ad_entity.description: The probe's raw reading. Give this or a moisture % sensor.

moisture_entity.name: Moisture % sensor
moisture_entity.description: Only for a probe without a raw AD sensor.

battery_entity.name: Battery sensor
battery_entity.description: Optional. Left out, the probe has no battery sensor.

reset_calibration.name: Reset calibration
reset_calibration.description: Go back to the model's default calibration, for a new probe. Off keeps the current calibration.

ad0.name: Raw AD at 0 %
ad0.description: Sets this calibration point. Needed with a raw AD sensor on a Generic probe that has none yet or is reset.

ad100.name: Raw AD at 100 %
ad100.description: Sets this calibration point. Needed with a raw AD sensor on a Generic probe that has none yet or is reset.
